title: Motorcycle Road Safety, Cornering Physics & Counter-Steering Techniques
description: Specialized motorcycle riding dynamics module examining counter-steering physics, corner entry lines, trail braking, and hazard avoidance.
learning_objectives: Master cornering dynamics terms (counter-steering, lean angle, apex, trail braking, cornering ABS, traction control)
Apply first conditionals and modal deduction to road hazard management
Eliminate Czech interference errors when explaining motorcycle physics and riding techniques

questions.prompt: To initiate a precise lean into a right-hand corner at speeds above 20 km/h, the rider _____ forward on the right handlebar grip.

explanations.correct: Modal 'must' is followed directly by the bare infinitive 'push' without 'to'.
explanations.wrong_A: 'must to' is ungrammatical; modal verbs never take 'to'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Po způsobovém slovesu 'must' následuje vždy základní tvar bez 'to': 'must push' (proti-řízení / counter-steering).

questions.prompt: If you grab the front brake lever aggressively while leaned over on wet painted road markings, the front tire _____ traction.

explanations.correct: First conditional result/fact: Present Simple ('loses') expresses the direct physical consequence of sudden traction loss.
explanations.wrong_A: 'will lose' is acceptable in predictive clauses, but 'loses' expresses the immediate physical law.
explanations.wrong_D: Past tense 'lost' conflicts with present condition 'grab'.

questions.cz_learning_point: V podmínkových větách vyjadřujících fyzikální zákonitosti se v hlavní větě používá přítomný čas: 'the front tire loses traction'.

questions.prompt: Always keep your head up and look far through the curve toward the exit _____ leaning through the corner apex.

explanations.correct: 'While' is a conjunction followed by an active participle clause ('while leaning through the corner apex').
explanations.wrong_B: 'During' is a preposition and cannot be followed directly by an active verb participle phrase.
explanations.wrong_D: 'Since' denotes elapsed time from a starting point.

questions.cz_learning_point: Spojka 'while' se pojí s dějem (while leaning = zatímco se nakláníte), zatímco předložka 'during' vyžaduje podstatné jméno.

questions.prompt: In an emergency stop from highway speeds, both front and rear brakes _____ smoothly and progressively to settle suspension pitch.

explanations.correct: Passive with modal 'should be applied' correctly describes the recommended riding technique.
explanations.wrong_A: Active 'should apply' lacks an object and implies brakes apply themselves.
explanations.wrong_B: 'should to be' is ungrammatical; modal 'should' does not take 'to'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Trpný rod se způsobovým slovesem: 'should be applied' (měly by být aplikovány / stlačeny). Brzdy nejednají aktivně samy o sobě.

questions.prompt: The touring group _____ through the Alpine mountain pass when an unexpected summer thunderstorm suddenly broke out.

explanations.correct: Past Continuous ('was riding') describes the ongoing background activity interrupted by 'broke out'.
explanations.wrong_A: Past Simple describes finished sequential events rather than ongoing background duration.
explanations.wrong_B: Present Simple is incorrect in past narratives.
explanations.wrong_D: Present Perfect cannot connect to past 'broke out'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Minulý průběhový čas (Past Continuous: 'was riding') vyjadřuje probíhající děj v minulosti, do kterého vstoupila náhlá bouřka.

questions.prompt: Motorcyclists wear certified CE-rated abrasion-resistant riding apparel _____ they remain protected in the event of an asphalt slide.

explanations.correct: 'So that' is a conjunction of purpose followed by a subject and modal verb clause ('they remain protected').
explanations.wrong_C: 'because of' is followed by a noun phrase, not a clause with a finite verb.

questions.cz_learning_point: Účelová spojka 'so that' = aby (následovaná celou větou: 'so that they remain protected').

questions.prompt: When following heavy trucks on wet motorways, riders should _____ back to stay out of the turbulent blind-spot spray zone.

explanations.correct: Phrasal verb 'hang back' (to maintain distance behind) takes base form after modal auxiliary 'should'.
explanations.wrong_A: 'hang up to' is an ungrammatical combination.
explanations.wrong_C: Past form 'hung back' is ungrammatical after modal 'should'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Frázové sloveso 'hang back' (držet si odstup / zůstat vzadu). Po způsobovém slovesu 'should' následuje základní tvar: 'should hang back'.

questions.prompt: Modern motorcycles feature lean-sensitive cornering ABS, _____ internal algorithms prevent front-wheel lockup even at high lean angles.

explanations.correct: Possessive relative pronoun 'whose' correctly links the antecedent 'cornering ABS' with its attribute 'internal algorithms'.
explanations.wrong_C: 'that' cannot be used in non-defining relative clauses set off by commas.

questions.cz_learning_point: Přivlastňovací vztažné zájmeno 'whose' (jehož interní algoritmy) vyjadřuje přivlastňovací vztah i u technických bezpečnostních systémů.

questions.prompt: Judging by the rainbow-colored sheen reflecting off the damp asphalt, there _____ a diesel fuel spill across the roadway.

explanations.correct: 'Must be' expresses logical deduction based on visual road surface clues.
explanations.wrong_A: 'must to be' is ungrammatical; modals never take 'to'.
explanations.wrong_B: 'can to be' is ungrammatical in English.

questions.cz_learning_point: Logická dedukce (určitě je / musí tam být nafta): 'there must be a diesel spill'. Nikdy *must to be*.

questions.prompt: Motorcyclists cannot negotiate off-camber hairpins with full confidence _____ they master vision targeting and smooth throttle pickup.

explanations.correct: 'Unless' expresses 'if not' or 'except when', stating the fundamental riding skill required.
explanations.wrong_A: 'if' produces an illogical statement (cannot negotiate IF they master).
explanations.wrong_C: 'provided that' creates an illogical positive condition.
explanations.wrong_D: 'as long as' also creates an illogical condition.

questions.cz_learning_point: 'Unless' = pokud ne (if not). Po 'unless' už v angličtině nenásleduje další zápor: 'unless they master vision targeting'.
